main.description: A sequence of timed events of arbitrary type, represented as data arrays.

id.description: Unique identifier for referencing this sequence.

sequences.description: Nested or referenced sequences. Nested sequences require an id field. May also reference external sequences via at:// URIs in the future.

origin.description: Points to a publication record (at://) or a publication url (https://). Avoid trailing slashes.

pathname.description: Combine with origin or to construct a canonical URL to the document. Prepend with a leading slash.

bskyPostRef.description: Strong reference to a Bluesky post. Useful to keep track of comments off-platform.

publishedAt.description: Timestamp of the documents publish time.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the documents last edit.

tags.description: Array of strings used to tag the sequence.

event.description: A timed event [beat, type, ...params]. First element, `beat`, must be a number, the second, `type`, must be a string. Additional parameters are type-specific and not validated to allow extensibility.

url.description: URL to credited person's profile or website
